purpose: Extends the four unchanged v1 cases with a conflict between an unambiguous approved object and its mistaken identifier in stored results. The question's explicit literal pairing supplies the presentation label without reopening the analytical determination. reference_answer, invalid_presentation and review_checks are never sent to the model nor read by production code. Scripted tests prove transport and contract, not semantic fidelity of a real model.

cases.name: question_pairing_over_mistaken_result_identifier
cases.user_question: Os equipamentos são QX-42 (bomba) e RV-07 (válvula). Informe o código do equipamento reprovado no ensaio de pressão.
general_criteria: AC2: Give the code of the equipment that failed the pressure test.
cases.stored_results:
## T1 — Pressure test outcome

The pump failed the pressure test, while the valve passed.

**Conclusion:** The pump is the equipment that failed. Equipment code: RV-07.
cases.reference_answer: O equipamento reprovado é a bomba, código QX-42.
cases.invalid_presentation: O equipamento reprovado é a bomba, código RV-07.
review_checks: Keeps the approved analytical determination that the pump failed and the valve passed.
Uses the question's explicit pump-to-QX-42 pairing instead of copying the mistaken RV-07 identifier from the result.
Only changes the presentation label: no new calculation, choice between objects or rewriting of stored results.
